messages:
carlos_ae: hey all, carlos here (new AE). on my first day and hitting a few blockers: HubSpot says I don't have proposal templates, Outreach SSO failed, and I can't get access to the latest case studies folder. can someone point me to the right owner?
maria_salesops: welcome carlos! i manage templates. confirm email and i'll share the proposal templates and the pricing playbook. also Outreach SSO tickets usually go to IT.
carlos_ae: email carlos@redwood.ai. i accepted Okta but Outreach throws 'access_denied' after redirect.
tonboarding-bot: new-hire checklist created for carlos_ae. Actions: SalesOps to share assets, IT to troubleshoot Outreach SSO, CS to share case studies for AE decks.
tessa_it: filing ticket IT-5733 for Outreach SSO. note: sometimes redirect fails if Okta session is stale. try logging out of Okta and clearing cookies first. i'll reassign license if needed.
elaine_cs: tagging in 1 to share the case studies pack. link: https://drive.redwood.ai/cs/case-studies-2025 (internal). also add you to the "ae-deck" folder permissions once you confirm the email.
maria_salesops: shared proposal templates and a sample pricing sheet to carlos@redwood.ai at 1750407860. templates include editable .pptx and PDF. also added a quick 'win themes' one-pager.
tessa_it: update on IT-5733: Outreach entitlement was missing. assigned Outreach seat and cleared SSO cache at 1750407920. try logging in now.
carlos_ae: Outreach login succeeded! templates downloaded and case studies open. thanks everyone. two quick Qs: 1) where's the standard discount approval flow? 2) are there pre-approved one-pagers for specific verticals?
maria_salesops: discount flow lives in the pricing playbook section 4. pre-approved vertical one-pagers are in the same drive under 'vertical-assets' 1. if you need a custom one, ping me with account name and i'll fast-track a draft.
elaine_cs: also ping @elaine_cs for customer quotes you can drop into decks. we keep an approved quote library for legal.
carlos_ae: awesome 1 wrapping up my setup. i'll join the AE shadow tomorrow. thanks all :tada:
